file_id: Sukumar Chakraborty-Vs.- State Of W.B vs Unknown on 7 October, 2024

sentences.text:
Sukumar Chakraborty-Vs.- State Of W.B vs Unknown on 7
October, 2024
3. 07.10..2024 Ct. 236 Asr In The High Court At Calcutta Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction C.R.R
4165 of 2024 In the matter of : Sukumar Chakraborty-Vs.- State of W.B Mr. Sakya Sen Mr. Surya
Sarathi Mr. Rahue Banerjee .....for the Petitioner Learned Advocate for the petitioner is present.
Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner.
Learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that the allegation made against his client is not maintainable.
Learned Advocate further draws attention to the copy of the F.I.R. and submits that the date of alleged occurrence is 14 years back from the date of filing of the F.I.R.

As the date of alleged occurrence comes to 8.3.2010 at that point of time Protection of Children from Sexual offences Act,
2012 was not framed.

entities.text:
Protection of Children from Sexual offences Act,
2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Although at the time of alleged offence POCSO Act was not framed but with regard to the other allegation namely Section 376(2)(d) (I)(n)/376(AB)/376(C) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code it was in existence.
At the very outset it appears that the case was instituted on the basis of reference made by West Bengal Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act.
On 6.03.2024 the reference was made on the basis of representation made by the victim of this case.

It further appears that although the complaint was made after 14 years from the date of alleged occurrence but case was instituted without making any preliminary inquiry.
Learned Advocate also draws attention to different documents showing the age of the victim as well as statements made in Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as representation made to the West Bengal Commission of Protection of Child Act.
Upon perusing the F.I.R. which was instituted after 14 years from the date of alleged offence without any explanation for delay of 14 years and the institution of case without making any preliminary enquiry and other material on records gives a valid ground to admit this case.

entities.text: West Bengal Commission of Protection of Child Act
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Thus this revisional application is admitted.

However, considering the fact that the petitioner is in custody and an application for bail is already pending, at this stage, it would be proper to hear the opposite parties before passing any order of stay of all further proceeding.
Let notice be issued upon the opposite parties and affidavit of service be filed on the returnable date.
Let the matter appear on 11.11.2024 as "contested Application".
As this matter is subjudice before this court.
Learned Trial Court may stay the proceeding on 6.11.2024, if such prayer is made and adjourn the matter to some other date.
